subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC2 package delivery - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: James Carter <j.carter@aureliatech.com>, Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@aureliatech.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: MAP draft & SOC2 package delivery - next steps

Hi James / Alice,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and appreciate the clarity on Aurelia's timeline. Attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) we discussed. Key milestone we flagged during the call is the Security review / SOC 2 package delivery.

Quick summary / ask:
- MAP milestone: "Security review & SOC2 package delivery" (see tab "Security/MAP").
- What we need from Aurelia: completed security questionnaire (attached PDF questionnaire), and the list of supporting evidence artifacts (in the checklist).
- Proposed dates: questionnaire answers by 2026-02-28, evidence delivery by 2026-03-03. Redwood to hand off SOC2 package (report copy, control matrix, evidence index) by 2026-03-05. Target close date for the overall deal: 2026-03-12.

Responsibilities (draft):
- Aurelia: complete questionnaire; assemble evidence artifacts (service configs, access lists, vendor contracts, retention policies where applicable). Point of contact: James Carter / Alice Nguyen.
- Redwood: compile SOC2 package, provide evidence index, and make time for a short 30-min walkthrough with your security team. Owners: Marissa (sales) + Rishi (security engineer) + Priya (CISO ops).

Dependencies / risks:
- If questionnaire responses are delayed > 3 business days, SOC2 package target will slip — we'll surface impact in the MAP and propose fallback dates.
- Some evidence items (e.g., vendor contract redactions) may require your legal review — flag early if that will take longer.

Attachments:
- MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones, owners, and dates)
- SOC2-evidence-checklist.pdf (detailed checklist of expected artifacts)

Next steps:
1) Please confirm you can meet the proposed questionnaire/evidence dates or suggest alternatives.
2) If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min security sync with Rishi for Friday morning.

Thanks—looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142
From: James Carter <j.carter@aureliatech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@aureliatech@aureliatech.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC2 package delivery - next steps

Marissa — thanks for the follow-up and the MAP. Appreciate the clear ownership. A few quick questions:

1) On the evidence checklist: can you confirm which items are mandatory vs. strongly recommended? For example, we have encrypted backups documented internally but may not have a single consolidated evidence artifact in the exact format listed.
2) Is the SOC2 package you're delivering a copy of Redwood's auditor report (if public) plus an evidence index, or is it the full attachments bundle? 

We should be able to get questionnaire answers back by 02/28 but I need to confirm with our security lead (looping in Alice). If we do the 30-min sync with Rishi, can we do Friday 10:00am PT?

Also bringing in our security distro (security@aureliatech.com) in case they want to weigh in on evidence acceptability.

Thanks,
James Carter
Director, IT Security | Aurelia Tech
j.carter@aureliatech.com | +1 617-555-0199

On Wed, Feb 25, 2026 at 3:10 PM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi James / Alice,
> 
> Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and appreciate the clarity on Aurelia's timeline...
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: James Carter <j.carter@aureliatech.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@aureliatech.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC2 package delivery - next steps

James — great questions, thanks. Answers inline below and I updated the MAP (attached v2) to reflect mandatory vs optional evidence items and tightened the milestone dates.

1) Mandatory vs recommended: we've flagged "mandatory" items in the checklist (red column). Mandatory typically includes: control descriptions, evidence of configurations (screenshots / export), change management tickets for control implementation, access control lists, and a basic vendor contract list. Recommended items include process narratives, runbooks, and training attestations. If something will take time to collect, call it out in the MAP and we'll accept partial artifacts + attestation for initial review.

2) SOC2 package contents: Redwood will provide:
- Auditor report (if non-confidential) OR a SOC2 summary + control matrix (we can provide either depending on your legal preference)
- Evidence index (map of each control to artifacts we can share)
- Sample artifacts where appropriate (config snips, export files)

Updated dates in MAP-Marissa-v2.xlsx (attached):
- Questionnaire answers due: 2026-02-28 (if you need more time, propose a date and we'll adjust)
- Evidence delivery due: 2026-03-03
- Redwood SOC2 package delivery: 2026-03-05
- Target close: 2026-03-12

Rishi and I are available for the sync — Friday 10:00am PT works. Priya will join from a policy/attestations perspective.

Attachments:
- MAP-Marissa-v2.xlsx (MAP with mandatory flag + updated dates)

If that looks good, I'll update the HubSpot timeline (HUBSPOT-54231) and prepare the DocuSign for the final SOW once we confirm evidence acceptance.

Best,
Marissa
From: James Carter <j.carter@aureliatech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@aureliatech.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 01 Mar 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC2 package delivery - next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clarification and the updated MAP. Confirming:
- We'll return completed questionnaire by 2026-02-28.
- Evidence bundle will be delivered by 2026-03-03 (we may send in batches; will flag items that need legal redaction).
- Friday 10:00am PT for the security sync works for our team.

Priya — appreciate you joining the sync; if there's a preferred evidence format that makes ingestion easier on your side, let us know.

I'll follow up with the security distro (security@aureliatech.com) with the questionnaire and checklist tomorrow.

Thanks — James
